web.named_query: ("Brandon Williams" OR "James Danly") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In February 2024 hearing remarks, Williams called AI a powerful and exciting tool, urged understanding its risks and opportunities, and advocated moving forward confidently. In those remarks, he also supported federal involvement in using AI to unlock insights from government-funded scientific datasets and described NAIRR investments as essential. In June 2026, Williams promoted combining AI, high-performance computing, and additive manufacturing to develop national-security capabilities faster while retaining human judgment.
